name: Kunal Kamra Heckling Arnab Goswami
visual_description: Side-by-side split screen of comedian Kunal Kamra talking enthusiastically on the left and journalist Arnab Goswami quietly ignoring him with sunglasses and earphones on a flight.
usage_context: Used to depict one person passionately explaining, ranting, or trying to get attention while the other person completely ignores them.

example.left_text: Me explaining why my startup idea will change the world
example.right_text: My dad looking at his newspaper

text_areas.description: Text describing the person talking endlessly or trying to get attention
Text describing the person completely ignoring or unbothered
